name: SAFO CRM Connector – Business Management Software
author: safoptl

sections.description:
SAFO is an all-in-one business management platform developed in Portugal that centralizes company operations into a single online system.
It includes modules for invoicing, CRM, scheduling, access control, local accommodation, inventory management, HR, communication, and more.

The SAFO CRM Connector is a plugin that connects WordPress with the SAFO ecosystem, enabling automatic data synchronization between your website and the platform.
If you are not yet a SAFO client, try it free at: https://31dias.safo.pt/

Features

This integration is designed for companies that use SAFO as their main management system and wish to connect their WooCommerce online store to the same professional and centralized environment.

  • Sync products and stock between WooCommerce and SAFO
  • Automatically update prices, images, and availability
  • Ensure consistent data between your online store and back office
sections.faq:
How can I start using the plugin?

You just need to have a SAFO account and follow the WooCommerce integration instructions available on our platform.
If you are not yet a SAFO client, you can try it free at: https://31dias.safo.pt/
sections.changelog:
1.0.0 (07/10/2025)

Initial release with the following features:

  • Product import from SAFO to WordPress
  • Automatic and manual stock synchronization
